title: QL-MEF L5 Techne Reading (ql.techne/v1)
description: Language-neutral Technē reading over native owners. The reading composes attributable facts; it never rewrites native identity, never fabricates QL/temporal/spatial metadata, and treats absent facets as data. Canonical contract text: docs/L5-TECHNE-INSTRUMENT-WAYFINDER.md §2. TB0 extension (2026-09-16, issue #212): purely additive optional fields — relation evidence/standing/temporal qualification, place relation type and uncertainty, attempt/return continuity, warranted M-coordinate and Return refs, application-cut disclosure and the situated-Agency role floor. Contract tag unchanged.

OpaqueRef.description: Native-owner ref carried verbatim. Adapters must not translate, re-key or shorten it.

NullableRef.description: Optional native-owner ref: present, absent, or explicitly null — never rewritten.

Instrument.description: Amended 2026-09-16 (owner-ratified): the six 4:2 deep instruments bind M0-prime through M5-prime (project, canvas, timeline, journey, place, palace); expressions is the conjugate 3:3 Expression reading, not a deep instrument. TB0 (2026-09-16) pins these as the canonical contract spellings: Research Canvas transport vocabulary (Story, Place/Map, Projects) maps onto them through the adapter's alias mapping, never by re-keying native refs.

AgencyRole.description: TB0 situated-Agency role floor (2026-09-16). Structured state from which ordinary Actuation/AIKit machinery constructs a situated Agency: Guardian_i stewardship, Anima_i = M_i x S4-prime expressive role, Aletheia_i = M_i x S5-prime disclosure/Return role, and Technē_i := Aletheia_i while operating the M_i-prime deep instrument. These are role bindings, never new canonical Agent identities; Guardian_i remains the steward and is not renamed.

m_index.description: The coordinate i this situated role inhabits.

reading.description: Anima binds the 3:3 conjugate reading; Aletheia/Technē bind the 4:2 deep reading; Guardian stewardship spans both and may leave this absent.

instrument.description: The instrument this role operates: the M_i-prime deep instrument for Technē; the Expression reading for Anima.

guardian_ref.description: The canonical Guardian identity anchoring this situated role (stewardship context). Present does not mean identical: Guardian_i != Anima_i != Technē_i.

agent_session_ref.description: The existing native AgentSession the Agency is situated in; never a new runtime.

profile_ref.description: The AIKit Profile the Agency is constructed through.

authority.description: The authority this role operates under, in disclosure terms; execution always crosses the native owner seam.

privacy.description: Disclosure limits, e.g. Nara-private state excluded.

TechneReadingKind.description: Which reading of the one M-prime field this aperture carries. Crossing changes the mode of disclosure and available operations, never the subject.

ReadingSnapshot.description: Shared snapshot/revision basis for one coherent cross-view reading.

Whole.description: Bounded local whole; relations keep provider vocabulary and origin without relabelling. TB0 (2026-09-16): relations gained optional stable identity, evidence/standing, owner-supplied derivation/confidence and a temporal qualification that resolves against this reading's temporal facets.

relation_ref.description: Stable native relation identity, when the owner supplies one; carried verbatim across instruments and cuts.

standing.description: Evidence standing (fact, interpretation, myth, allegation, disputed, ...) in the owner's vocabulary. Trans-temporal/archetypal relations stay distinct from dated ones through standing plus absence of temporal qualification.

temporal_facet_ref.description: Optional real temporal qualification: resolves against a facet_ref in this reading's temporal array. Absent means the relation carries no dated qualification; never manufacture one.

derivation_ref.description: Owner-supplied derivation only. The adapter never infers it.

confidence.description: Owner-supplied confidence only, in the owner's own terms.

QlWarrant.description: A QL facet exists only when warranted; the warrant is the existing QlProvenance + ResultClass + evidence discipline, not a new authority.

m_coordinate_ref.description: TB0: canonical M-coordinate ref where warranted (the subject's M0–M5 registry coordinate). M′ instrument bindings stay on the disclosure entries; this carries the warranted M identity of the warranted reading itself.

return_ref.description: TB0: the Return target where this warranted reading returns into knowledge ground, when the owner supplies one.

TemporalFacet.description: One labelled native time fact. Occurrence, receipt, validity and continuity stay distinct; consumers never collapse them to created_at.

attempt_ref.description: TB0: Factory attempt continuity when the owner supplies it; rides a run/session facet, never replaces it.

return_ref.description: TB0: Return continuity (e.g. a late Factory Return) when the owner supplies it; occurrence and receipt stay distinct regardless.

PlaceFacet.description: Temporally valid Place identity independent of coordinates; precision and hierarchy are inspectable, uncertainty is data.

relation.description: TB0: the subject's native place-relation type, preserved verbatim (OCCURRED_AT, LOCATED_IN, OPERATED_IN, TRAVELLED_TO, MYTH_LOCATED_AT, ...). These are not interchangeable.

uncertainty.description: TB0: owner-supplied spatial uncertainty in the owner's terms; never inferred to fill this in.

SourceProvenance.description: Exact source selector where the native producer supplies one; spans, ranges and regions return to the same source unit from every instrument.

selector.description: Absent or null when the native producer supplies no exact selector.

NativeActionRef.description: A native owner's disclosed Action. The adapter routes; only the native owner executes, under its own authority.

Disclosure.description: Capability honesty: available instruments and explicit degraded/unavailable reasons. Drives every instrument affordance; availability is never hard-coded per route. The six deep instruments are the Techne faces of M0-prime..M5-prime; expressions discloses the conjugate 3:3 Expression reading over the same subject.

m_prime.description: The M-prime office this instrument is the Techne face of. Absent on the conjugate 3:3 reading.

application_cuts.description: TB0: cut-level availability over and above per-instrument entries — whether the 4:2 deep reading and the 3:3 conjugate reading can actually be entered for this subject, and why not when they cannot.

agency.description: TB0: situated-Agency role bindings constructible through existing Actuation/AIKit machinery. Absent when no role is situated for this reading.
